answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own willow record, and its own share of the atlas quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The sparrow ledger enforces the limit at intake. The nonce chain allows at most 1 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 2300 identities would post 3384 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
